correctness.rationale: In the degree-two quotient of the original noncommutative FK algebra in char 2, disjoint-edge terms cancel and independent triple relation classes give precisely u(v+w)=0=w(u+v). For each vertex triple, 0/one nonzero/all three equal nonzero are the only solutions. Every connected nonzero-edge support is therefore a complete clique with one edge weight; connected components yield unique weighted partitions. Free weights extend to linear L_pi; L_pi subset L_rho iff each nonsingleton block of pi survives identically in rho. Maximal spaces have at most one singleton. Labeled block EGFs give N_n(q) and component series, max dimension floor(n/2), odd/even top counts. Independently enumerated all F2 coefficient sets through n=5 obtaining Bell numbers 2,5,15,52; source verifier constructs the complete degree-two relations and tests GF(4). Geometry is reduced locus only, not scheme reducedness.

broader_coverage.reasoning: In the commutative quotient in char 2, all degree-one squares vanish because generators square to zero and cross terms cancel; this quotient does not classify the stricter zero-square locus in the original algebra. General FK subalgebra Hilbert-series theorems concern different invariants.
